plan.question: Do loss weighting and PCGrad change local useful-lead event-loss update directions when actual AdamW moments and weight decay are retained?
plan.data: One fixed 256-row training batch per shard, all 48 training shards and original three seeds; no calibration statistics or test access.
plan.reporting: Report all four cells, all events and seeds; raw-gradient versus actual AdamW first-order and same-dropout observed loss changes. Restore the same source checkpoint and optimizer before every virtual step. No new fitted model or checkpoint is saved.
plan.interpretation: Descriptive local probes, not a gradient-conflict diagnosis or prediction of alternative full-training outcomes. Equal weights preserve total loss weight 5.5. All virtual steps start with moments learned under original weights.

validation.limit: Checks the uploaded export and recorded provenance, not unavailable original raw payloads

limits: Local final-checkpoint probes use the original optimizer moments and identical dropout within each comparison. A virtual step includes AdamW preconditioning, stored momentum and weight decay; it does not identify training-trajectory effects or predict held-out warning performance. Batch rows are dependent and no IID uncertainty is claimed.
